issues.description: native-022, native-026 and native-037 describe exact 2005/2011 plasmids, hosts and preparations, but their endpoint qualifiers cite only generic native heterologous-host evidence codes. Independent primary reading supports the biology, so this is a source-local provenance defect, not disproven catalysis.
